notes.title: ユーザーインターフェースの変更
notes.notes:
いつも「鉄道運転士VR」をプレイして頂きありがとうございます。

今回は以下の点を変更いたしました。

・触れるもしくは掴めるオブジェクトの特徴
上部にカーソルが表示されるようになりました。

・ヘルプの追加
オブジェクトの掴み方やゲームの目的を表示するようにしました。

・ゴールラインの変更
視認性向上のためにアーチ状に変更しました。

notes.title: Change of some user interface
notes.notes:
Thank you for always playing "Train Simulator VR".

We added the following elements to this game yesterday.

・Characteristic of the object group which you can touch it or can grab
A cursor came to be displayed on an object.

・Addition of the help
For example, how to grab objects and the purpose of the game.

・Appearance of the goal line
Goal line changed into a an arch form to give visibility.

notes.title: Updated in January 2018
notes.notes:
· Add actual performance function
Remarks: The performance of 6 items was added. The actual name is the following six items.
"First drive" "First run" "Trial clear" "Stage 1 clear" "Stage 2 clear" "Stage 3 clear"

· Route expansion
"Stage 3" "Mizushi Town - Strong sasha" was newly added.

· Vehicle type, locomotive adjustment
We processed the window of the locomotive widely.

notes.title: Updated in December 2017
notes.notes:
· Vibration function added to mascon&brake
Remarks: It is easy to grasp the state of grasping the mascon or brake

· Adjust start position
Remarks: The direction in which the PC monitor was placed at HTC-Vive was made to be in front.
Also, the center of the room scale has been modified to be the position of the player in every scene.

Adjustment of signal position
Remarks: Rearrangement of the red light on the icy road to the mushrooms was fixed

· Correction of glare with ground
Remarks: The part that was confirmed at Aizu - Mushi mounds was fixed

· Sound adjustment
Remarks: The sound is made to sound at the turn of the strength of the muscon and the brake.
Originally, the part where the sound does not sound at the place where the sound sounds was corrected.
